name: Archeological Historian
body:
Archeological Historian CR 1/2

XP 400
LN Medium humanoid (human)
Human expert 2
Init +0; Senses Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 10, flat-footed 11 (+1 armor)
hp 11 (2d8+2); 9 currently injured
Fort +1, Ref +0, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spear +1 (1d8/x3)
Ranged spear +1 (1d8/x3)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 10, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 9
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 11
Feats Skill Focus (Knowledge [geography]), Skill Focus (Knowledge [history])
Skills Climb +5*, Heal +5, Knowledge (geography) +10, Knowledge (history) +10, Knowledge (local) +7, Knowledge (nature) +7, Linguistics +6, Perception +5, Survival +5, Swim +4; * +7 when using climber’s kit
Languages Common, Elven, Goblin, Sylvan
Gear quilted cloth armor, 2 spears, hunting knife, waterskin, compass, climber’s kit, bedroll, backpack, quill, ink pot, map of the local area, 10 sheets of paper

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Geographical Guru (Ex)

Whenever an archeological historian makes a Survival skill check to keep from getting lost or discern true North, they gain a +1 insight bonus.
